Information Technology (IT) at CMRTC is a 4-year B.Tech program that focuses on computer systems, software development, data management, networking, and emerging technologies. Our IT department provides state-of-the-art facilities and industry-aligned curriculum.

The IT department at CMRTC has an excellent placement record with 85% placement rate. Our students are placed in top companies like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, and many more. The average package ranges from 4.5 to 8 LPA, with the highest package being 12 LPA. We have strong industry connections and provide pre-placement training to ensure our students are industry-ready.

Eligibility criteria for IT Engineering at CMRTC: 1) Minimum 50% aggregate in 10+2 (PCM), 2) Valid EAMCET/JEE score, 3) Compulsory subjects: Physics & Mathematics with either Chemistry or Computer Science, 4) Minimum passing marks required in each subject.
The B.Tech in Information Technology at CMRTC is a 4-year full-time program divided into 8 semesters. Each semester includes theory courses, practical labs, and project work.
